The dance, matching the reference second by second, sharp arm moves on the beat of a 2000s electro club track:

1-2 s: both arms straight up.
2-4 s: the hands come to the face, the arms cross in front of the chest and roll past the face.
4-7 s: arms straight out to the sides, palms up, quick snaps to the side, one hand to the head.
7-10 s: hands to the head and the chest, elbows out, arms spread wide again.
10-15 s: side steps, one arm swings over the head, the other hand on the chest.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. Two arms and two hands, no extra limbs, even in the fastest moves. The people in the crowd keep their own faces and never get the dancer's face. No text, no logos, no watermark, no other dancers on the stage.
